event.title: A plan for the crossings of ashwatch
event.speaker: court-0
event.text:
Sora Riverwake spreads a working plan across your desk. The ford is failing. Villages want a safe crossing; merchants want a faster one. Whose road will you build?

“Give us a direction, and name the person whose judgment you trust. The seal carries your authority; the work will carry their abilities.”

storyDeck.speaker: court-0
storyDeck.text:
Sora Riverwake spreads a working plan across your desk. The ford is failing. Villages want a safe crossing; merchants want a faster one. Whose road will you build?

“Give us a direction, and name the person whose judgment you trust. The seal carries your authority; the work will carry their abilities.”

storyDeck.title: Beyond the safe road · Ashwatch
storyDeck.speaker: company-0-0
storyDeck.text:
Lysa Mossfoot requests a private audience. At Ashwatch, a winged beast has claimed a forgotten watchtower. A sealed room beneath Ashwatch contains a charter with a royal name scratched away. The realm needs people who can ask difficult questions and return with more than a tale.

“A company can go where the watch should not be spent. Tell us whether this journey is about haste, careful knowledge, or the trust of the people who remember this place.”

storyDeck.title: Two prayers at one threshold · The Mistbrook Abbey
storyDeck.speaker: petitioner-shrine-duel
storyDeck.text:
Rain taps the high windows as a visitor is shown inside. Fern Quickburrow, household representative for The hearths of Oakwick, arrives from The Mistbrook Abbey. You notice rabbit features, a blue traveling cloak. The petitioners arrive with two different lamps and the same kind of bread.

“Two congregations want the same restored shrine for their holy night. Both cleaned the ruins; both claim an older promise. Their youngest members have been sharing bread outside.”

Kiva Stormfur waits beside your chair. The witnesses have carried their testimony a long way. They are asking what your protection means.

storyDeck.title: A place at your table · Eris Duskwing
storyDeck.speaker: candidate-1
storyDeck.text:
The chamberlain introduces Eris Duskwing from Ashwatch. Before coming to court, Eris Duskwing worked as a border scout in Ashwatch. They translated a forgotten charter that changed an entire valley’s future. generous by habit and restless in difficult company, they have arrived with their own hopes rather than an empty oath.

“A promise is only useful when someone can live by it.” Their hope is to win a lasting place for travelers and newcomers. Your court can grow through talent, but every new chair brings obligations as well as gifts.
